findings.result: Preexisting ACTIVE, empty, same-name tables in us-east-1/us-east-2, both PAY_PER_REQUEST, pk string HASH schema and NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES streams, were rejected with ValidationException: One or more parameter values were invalid: DynamoDB global tables version 2017.11.29 is not supported. findings.label: create-validation-precedence
findings.result: Empty ReplicationGroup reports Global table must have atleast one replica. Missing top-level fields report generic invalid parameters; missing replica region, invalid region enum and invalid table-name length validate before legacy prohibition. Nonempty single/current/other/duplicate/reversed groups report legacy prohibition regardless of missing or ordinary source/target tables.

findings.label: update-create-versus-delete-precedence
findings.result: Create action is prohibited before global-table lookup. Valid Delete-only actions on ordinary tables reach GlobalTableNotFoundException instead. Empty list or empty entry is generic invalid parameters; missing RegionName is shape validation; an entry containing both Create and Delete is rejected explicitly.

findings.label: current-version-is-not-legacy-catalog-state
findings.result: Real ACTIVE version-2019.11.21 replica tables did not appear in DescribeGlobalTable (GlobalTableNotFoundException) or valid ListGlobalTables results (GlobalTables empty) at actual member endpoints east1/east2 or nonmember west2. No native list rows were omitted. Delete-only UpdateGlobalTable, including duplicate deletes and nonexistent target, returned GlobalTableNotFoundException. CreateGlobalTable or any valid Update Create action returned legacy-not-supported. The rejected operations left the real current-version group present.

findings.label: list-native-input-bounds
findings.result: List Limit 0/-1 failed min1 validation; 101, 1000 and signed-int32 maximum 2147483647 were accepted. Invalid RegionName bad-region at all three endpoints and empty RegionName at east1 returned native InternalServerError, not enum validation. ExclusiveStartGlobalTableName x failed minimum length 3.

findings.label: newer-region-enum-contrast
findings.result: For valid modern region eu-north-1, CreateGlobalTable and Delete-only UpdateGlobalTable return a legacy-region availability ValidationException, before lookup, naming only eu-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1, ap-southeast-2, ap-northeast-2, eu-central-1, ap-northeast-1, us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-1 and us-west-2. Update Create with eu-north-1 instead returns the generic legacy-not-supported error. Exact native legacy/current availability lists and ordering are retained. No resources were created there.

findings.label: cloudtrail-management-envelope
findings.result: All four operations appeared as AwsApiCall management events. Describe/List readOnly true; Create/Update false. Native responseElements is null for sampled errors and successful List. Table-specific calls retain endpoint regional AWS::DynamoDB::Table ARN in detailed event resources, not a global-table ARN; List omits detailed resources. Outer LookupEvents Resources remains an empty array and must not be confused with detailed event resources.

findings.label: list-known-region-routing
findings.result: At the us-east-1 endpoint, ListGlobalTables accepted both RegionName eu-north-1 and us-gov-west-1, returning HTTP 200 and GlobalTables: []. Known modern commercial and noncommercial regions therefore differ from invalid/empty RegionName, which returned HTTP 500 in this run. No resources were created in either filter region.

limitations: New legacy creation is natively prohibited in the authorized account during this experiment. No valid legacy global-table state was created or simulated. Legacy GlobalTableArn, CreationDateTime, GlobalTableStatus, successful Create/Update, duplicate-existing legacy creation, legacy membership attach/detach, single-member degeneration, replica-removal data preservation and successful legacy-group pagination are unreachable in this run.

The observed prohibition prevents empirically establishing historical stream/schema/nonempty admission constraints. Missing regional table and disabled-stream contrasts were captured. A direct attempt to change an enabled stream view failed natively (sequence 54), triggered cleanup, and was not treated as legacy admission evidence. Per parent directive no further schema/nonempty legacy-only fixtures were pursued after valid prerequisites proved the prohibition.

No legacy group exists in these owned resources, so member/nonmember legacy endpoint behavior cannot be observed. Current-version actual member endpoints us-east-1/us-east-2 and nonmember us-west-2 were probed instead; no resources were created in us-west-2.

List results retain only owned table rows. Any unrelated returned rows or unrelated pagination name are omitted with explicit per-call omission fields. Empty native results are retained without invented entries. Pagination with successful legacy groups could not be exercised.

No IAM objects were created or modified by this probe; preexisting shared IAM roles/policies were not deleted. PITR was never enabled. No tables contained application items. Current-version replica creation/removal was used only to establish the current-version legacy-API contrast.

CloudTrail event-history lookups are bounded observations, not timing guarantees. Selected native envelopes preserve requestParameters, responseElements, resources and error fields; accessKeyId omitted. Unrelated events were discarded before persistence.
